semantics: Per-file count of `Effect.Effect<..., unknown, ...>` signatures — an Effect whose error channel is untyped while 120 `Data.TaggedError` classes exist — owned by src/test-kernel/architecture/unknownErrorChannelRatchet.vitest.ts (.agents/docs/proposed/simplification/2026-09-20-effect-facility-adoption.md section 2, step 5). Scope: *.ts, *.tsx, *.mts and *.cts under src/ and packages/*/src/, excluding src/test-kernel/ and *.d.ts. Files are parsed with the TypeScript compiler API, so a comment or a string literal never counts; a site counts when the type reference is the qualified name Effect.Effect and its SECOND type argument is exactly the `unknown` keyword. Same mechanism as the effect-migration ratchet: counts are shrink-only and exact. A count that rose, or a file absent from `files` with a site in it, fails; a count that shrank also fails, because the leftover is room a later PR could regrow into unnoticed — lower the entry in the same PR, and delete the entry when the file reaches zero. Typing a channel is `catchTag` where the failure is already a tagged member; the `instanceof` sites in packages/llm/src/openaiResponses.ts and packages/desktop/src/main/desktopFileSelection.ts narrow untagged values thrown by foreign or synchronous APIs and take `catchIf` or typed construction at the boundary instead.
